node.text: I want to congratulate my mom Susan Pearlman for an amazing job today becoming a Bat Mitzvah at the age of 75!! She put in a lot of work over the last year and it showed today. So proud of you mom!!
10-8-25. Today is the 4 year anniversary of our first date!! With the love of my life Vickie Olkowski ❤️❤️. Happy Anniversary Babe!!
Happy Birthday to my beautiful daughter Rylee!!❤️❤️She is now an adult wow how time flies!!
Life happens!! Now I have a kid at Temple!! Who would have thought!!!!

When you decide to have children, you realize one day they will graduate high school and be off on their own. I can’t believe that day has come! Proud beyond belief of what this young lady has accomplished.  Through ups and do of life Rylee only knew one way.  That was UP!! Congratulations @ryleepearlman

Where has the time gone??? My little girl is now all grown up graduating High School and off to College!! Such a beautiful, smart, caring, and overall wonderful woman. So proud of you Rylee Pearlman!! You Rock!!
